messages:
Marco: Heads up — OrionCloud just flagged a customs paperwork hold on the EU rack shipment. They're holding 12 reserved racks for Q3 Dedicated under our reservation IDs.
Sophie: Do we have a quick breakdown of which reservations/customers are affected?
Marco: Quick list: EU-DC-1 -> 5 racks (cust A, cust B), EU-DC-2 -> 7 racks (cust C, internal test). I'll paste manifest in a sec.
Ashwin: Ugh. Any ETA on release from customs? If it's >72h we should trigger fallback.
LogisticsBot: Automated update: shipment ORC-9847 status changed to "documentation hold". Current ETA +6 days pending paperwork clearance. https://orioncloud.example/shipments/ORC-9847
Ellie: Customer success here — please confirm affected accounts so we can notify SLA teams and offer short-term credits if needed.
Marco: Copying manifest snippet:
```
reservation_ids: [R-7321, R-7322, R-7323, R-7324, R-7325, R-7326, R-7327, R-7328, R-7329, R-7330, R-7331, R-7332]
partner: OrionCloud
hold_reason: customs - missing C88 paperwork
```
Sophie: Can OrionCloud push alternate racks from their EU buffer? What's their buffer count?
Ashwin: Reached out to Orion partner ops — they have 3 spare racks in EU-DC-3 and a potential hot-swap with ByteCloud for 4 more if we sign a short addendum. Lead time for hot-swap ~24-36h if legal OK.
Ellie: OK — CS will draft a proactive note to impacted accounts with two paths: (1) temporary hot-swap with potential staggered onboarding, (2) wait for customs release (~6 days). Which option do we prefer to offer first?
Marco: Prioritize hot-swap where feasible, escalate dedicated customers with contractual SLAs. Sophie / Ashwin can you confirm technical compatibility for hot-swaps today?
Sophie: Checking image versions and rack configs now, will confirm within 2 hours. If all good, ask partner ops to start swap.
Ashwin: On it. Also creating a quick runbook in the partnerships repo for this exact scenario (doc-hold -> buffer swap -> CS notification). Will tag @Legal if we need a short addendum.
Ellie: Thanks — please ping when we have the final list. I'll queue the customer emails as draft templates.
Marco: Agree. Post any updates here. :eyes:
Sophie: Update: configs look compatible for 9/12 racks. Orion to confirm transport; starting swap for those 9. Remaining 3 will be prioritized once customs clears.
LogisticsBot: Automated update: partner ORC-9847 added "docs_uploaded" flag at 3623456805. Status: pending customs review.
Ashwin: Noted. I'll coordinate the addendum for ByteCloud fallback in parallel. :+1:
Ellie: Drafts queued. Will send once swap confirmed.
Marco: Closing loop — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if customs delays beyond current ETA"
